caseName: Alaska Pacific Steamship Co. v. Industrial Accident Commission of California
caseNameFull: Alaska Pacific Steamship Company, in Error v. Industrial Accident Commission of the State of California
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of California.
attorneys: Mr. Ira A. Campbell and Mr. Edward J. McCutchen for plaintiff in error., Mr. Christopher M. Bradley for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Stipulations of counsel to the effect that the same judgments may be entered in' these cases as in case No. 476, (next supra) having been filed, the judgments are therefore reversed and the eases remanded for further proceedings.
